name: Wisp
author: E. T. Carter
description: Two or three pale teardrop flames wander weightlessly over dark marsh water, their FBM-flickered bodies dragging thin fading filaments that trace the quasi-periodic path each one just travelled. A barely-there mist band breathes along the bottom edge; each flame carries a slightly different cool palette tint and the composite never visibly repeats.

params.label: Wander speed
params.effect: How quickly the flames travel their meandering paths; pauses and swerves compress or stretch with it.

params.label: Flame size
params.effect: Height of each teardrop flame in CSS pixels; width and halo scale proportionally.

params.label: Density
params.effect: How many wisps span the frame (field density); higher fills the marsh with a dense swarm.

params.label: Flicker
params.effect: Amplitude of the FBM interior flicker; 0 is a calm steady glow, 2 gutters like a flame in wind.

params.label: Atmosphere
params.effect: Breathing marsh-gas glow that fills the frame behind the wisps so the field never reads as dead black.

params.label: Colour spread
params.effect: How far each flame's hue ranges across the palette; 0 is a single tint, 1 spreads the full set.

params.label: Brightness
params.effect: Overall emission of the flames (bodies, cores, halos and trails) over the atmosphere.

params.label: Colour vividness
params.effect: Vividness of the flame colours; 0 is greyscale, 1 is the raw palette, higher pushes saturation.
